summary: Arcos Dorados, the NYSE-listed McDonald's franchisee, furnished a Form 6-K containing its third-quarter 2026 earnings release and disclosed that the Board approved an open-market share repurchase program of up to $25 million of Class A shares, to be bought and canceled over the next six months. The buyback sits within a newly articulated capital allocation framework prioritizing high-return capex, balance-sheet strength, dividends and repurchases. Q3 revenue reached $1.3 billion, up 11.3%, with Adjusted EBITDA of $125.9 million. No advisor or pricing premium was stated. Watch cadence of repurchases and liquidity.
